name: Falling Portcullis Trap

stealth.details: (expert) to spot the sockets in the floor where the portcullis drops; DC 28 Perception check (expert) to spot the floor trigger

disable: DC 27 Thievery check (expert) to disable the floor trigger, or DC 27 Athletics check or DC 27 Engineering-lore check to jam the portcullis in the ceiling

items.name: Slam Shut
items.text:
Trigger The pressure plate is depressed

---

Effect The portcullis falls, closing off the hallway. Any creature under the portcullis when it drops takes 4d10+18 piercing damage and is Immobilized. A creature that succeeds at a DC 26 Reflex save save takes no damage and rolls away in a random direction; on a critical success, they can choose the direction.

If the trap was triggered by a creature moving north with a Speed of at least 10 feet, they're considered to be under the portcullis when it triggers. Creatures moving south when triggering the portcullis aren't considered to be under the portcullis when it triggers.

text: An iron portcullis drops from the ceiling when a pressure plate is triggered.
